prior_source: Original JWPE_article_clean_package/src/aerbench/surrogate.py, SurrogateParams literal defaults; no calibrated parameter JSON loaded. The fixed normalized biomass response and scales are historical BSM1-derived empirical information shared by both process models.
reference_eval_window: native step right endpoints [60,67); matches first-round reference
temperature_scope: constant native 15C influent; tempmodel=False disables the state balance, not kinetic temperature compensation
primary_control: delete only -0.4*r_h -2.5*r_a from the SO balance; retain all other rates, states, shared closures and assumptions
ablation_scope: conditional value of oxygen-demand feedback inside this empirical model; ablation deliberately omits oxygen demand and is not a physical replacement
historical_information: fixed shared biomass closure and fixed assumptions retain historical information; two process models share it exactly; shared-closure logistic receives its XH/XA targets
causal_scope: controlled local feedback contrast, not universal architectural or mechanism-versus-statistics causality
loss: mean squared probability residual (Brier); process probability sigmoid((4-SNH)/0.5), logistic expit(linear standardized features)
fit_policy: 3 predefined starts; max 800 nfev/start; minimum converged development loss; no test-driven model choice
secondary_policy: coarse 200 cases only. Process parameters fit once at 4; never refit for 2,3,5,6. Logistic separately fits each threshold from the same already available 750 development peak concentrations; extra supervision and fitting reported
raw_outputs: primary screening classification and coarse/dense boundary localization; guard does not erase raw errors
query_policy: offline replay of frozen predictions and newly paid references; only queried values reach callbacks; counts are hypothetical deployment queries, not new integrations or serial wall-time savings
deployment_policy: joint-condition outside domain uses full reference grid; guided-only search is a separately named diagnostic comparison
statistics: 8 predetermined condition clusters, descriptive paired differences; grid points and thresholds are correlated and not independent experimental replicates
numerical_gate: each process model: all 750 finite RK4 versus training steady predictions; 1 vs 0.5 minute audit on predicted boundaries; count all projection interventions
study_cost: all new candidates independently reference simulated, including dense points, plus separately counted half-minute audits; historical 750 not newly simulated
